note: Author-reserved notation resolutions (Architecture.md Sections 12.1, 16.4). Keyed by compound notation identity: a \mathrm{...} base plus its normalised subscript chain (e.g. 'Alg', 'Alg_f', 'Sub', 'Sub_f', 'Form_Cgr_fi'), or a bare macro ('delta', 'Omega'). resolution is 'block' (with a 'target' defining block; symbol-usage edges are emitted to it) or 'ambient' (the notation yields no dependency edge). decided_by must begin with 'author:'. An identity absent here that is not mechanically unique is reported as unresolved by scripts/ingest.py.

Delta.rationale: equivalence-level least element; B-D024 is the algebra analogue built on it

Omega.rationale: B-D038 constructs the operator; B-D039 names it and depends on it

Sub.rationale: overloaded subsets (B-D005) vs subalgebras (B-D020); ambient pending a context rule

supp_S.rationale: root support definition; B-D018 is the algebra support defined from it
